title: Zero Sugar Chinese Pork Noodles
description: A diabetic-friendly Cantonese dish featuring a floral and comforting combination of ground pork and noodles, with a cheese-pull effect from the pasta water emulsion.
instructions: Cook the shirataki noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground pork until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the coconut aminos, ginger, and scallions to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the monk fruit sweetener and xanthan gum and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the pork mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, to allow the flavors to meld and the sauce to thicken.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the cheese-pull effect to develop.
